title: Apply AI | AI Resume Builder & Auto Apply to Jobs 24/7
excerpt: Create ATS-optimized resumes in minutes & let AI auto-apply to hundreds of jobs while you sleep. Try free today!
content_html:
AI resume builderlet AI apply to jobs for you

You drive

You write it,
with help.

Paste a posting. Talk to the draft. Watch the CV rebuild beside the conversation.

It drives

Or it writes it,
while you don't.

Set your roles once and let AI apply for you. Auto Apply keeps submitting tailored applications — it runs on JobCopilot, a separate service with its own subscription.

Billed by JobCopilot, separately from Apply AI.

Is your resume good enough?

Free ATS score in 30 seconds — no signup needed. Then let AI fix it, tailor it to any job, and write your cover letters.

Click to upload or drag and drop your resume

PDF, DOC, DOCX • Max 5MB

Your data is secure

AI-powered optimization

No credit card needed

Your data stays private

In the Studio

  1. 01

    Bring your CV

    Upload it once. We read it and keep it on file for every application after that.

  2. 02

    Paste the posting

    A link or the text. We pull out the company, the role and what they are asking for.

  3. 03

    Talk to the draft

    Ask for changes in plain language and watch the CV update beside the conversation.

With Auto Apply

  1. 01

    Bring your CV

    The same profile the Studio uses — signing in carries it over, so there is no second setup. Billing stays separate.

  2. 02

    Set your preferences

    Roles, locations and salary expectations. Change them whenever you like.

  3. 03

    Close the tab

    Matching jobs get a tailored application without you opening the site again.

Either way, the same application lands.

Whichever way you get there, your Apply AI plan brings all of this with it.

24 resume templates

Switch template without starting over — the content carries across.

ATS scoring

Your score, and exactly which of the posting's keywords are missing.

Cover letters

Written from the same posting as the CV, so the two agree with each other.

Interview practice

Practise against questions drawn from the role you applied for.

Job recommendations

Roles matched to the profile you have already uploaded.

Application tracking

Every application in one pipeline, from draft through to offer.

Simple Pricing

Choose Your Plan

Start free and upgrade when you're ready. All paid plans include every feature.

50% OFF— Limited time offer on all paid plans

Free

$0/month

Perfect for getting started

  • Generate AI-tailored resumes (watermarked)
  • Generate cover letters
  • 3 applications per month
  • Basic resume templates

Trusted by job seekers worldwide

Secure payments

Cancel anytime

No hidden fees

Start with the free plan.

Three applications a month, no charge. Upgrade when it is doing enough work to be worth it.

Apply AI plans cover the Studio and everything above. Auto Apply is billed by JobCopilot and is not included — and an Auto Apply subscription does not include Apply AI.
